provenance.post_title: Time is Running Out! Back Pathfinder Quest Today!
provenance.asset_description: Promotional banner with text and an illustration background. The text says 'Time is running out to join the quest! Pathfinder Quest, over 800% funded! Back it now on Backerkit!' The background is an illustration of pathfinder iconics Merisiel, Valeros, and Ezren battling a large purple skinned time dragon.
